summary: Legacy pass-through to cross_platform_report; the caller sets the real sub-action inside params['action'] (blended_performance|channel_comparison|top_campaigns|revenue_attribution). With no params['action'] the handler's Literal type makes 'action' a required arg.

params.name: action
params.doc: REQUIRED inside params for this route (legacy_action is None so nothing is injected). The handler signature types action as a Literal with no default -> pydantic requires it.

params.name: date_range_start
params.doc: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; defaults via default_date_range to 30 days back. NOTE: param is 'date_range_start', NOT 'start_date'.

params.name: date_range_end
params.doc: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today. NOTE: 'date_range_end', NOT 'end_date'.

params.name: platforms
params.doc: Array of strings; normalized via name_map (google/gads->google_ads, fb/facebook->meta, tt->tiktok, snapchat->snap). Filters which connected platforms are queried.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: top_campaigns only; invalid value silently falls back to 'spend'.

params.name: limit
params.doc: top_campaigns row cap. NOTE: param is 'limit', NOT 'n'.

returns: Depends on params['action']; see the specific sub-action rows. | {error,...}

summary: Multi-touch revenue attribution: fetches ad spend in parallel, resolves a revenue source (warehouse>ga4>adobe>amplitude>self_reported>spend_only), distributes channel credit per the chosen model, and returns per-channel spend/attributed_revenue/ROAS/CAC. IMPLEMENTED (handler present) — the docstring warning that it 'may not be registered' is FALSE.

params.name: model
params.doc: Attribution model. linear/time_decay/position_based are session-share APPROXIMATIONS (flagged in response). shapley/markov rejected with unsupported_model.

params.name: revenue_source
params.doc: Force a revenue source; 'auto' walks the hierarchy. Invalid value -> unsupported_revenue_source error.

params.name: ga4_property_id
params.doc: Required for the ga4 channel source (numeric IDs accepted as int/str via CoercedStr BeforeValidator).

params.name: warehouse_platform
params.doc: Warehouse engine for the ground-truth total adapter (needs revenue_table too).

params.name: revenue_table
params.doc: Qualified table (dataset.table BQ, or table RS/SF); validated via validate_qualified_identifier before interpolation.

params.name: revenue_column
params.doc: Revenue column (quoted/validated).

params.name: order_id_column
params.doc: Date/order column used in the WHERE DATE(...) clause; falls back to 'created_at' in the adapter if falsy.

params.name: channels
params.doc: Array of strings; optional case-insensitive filter applied to attributed channels.

params.name: attribution_window_days
params.doc: Echoed in the response; NOT actually applied to any windowing logic in this sync handler.

params.name: conversion_event
params.doc: Echoed in the response; NOT used to filter GA4/Adobe queries in this handler.

params.name: amplitude_project_id
params.doc: Passed to the amplitude TOTAL-only adapter.

params.name: adobe_report_suite_id
params.doc: Required for the adobe_analytics channel source.

params.name: adobe_org_id
params.doc: Adobe IMS org id.

params.name: date_range_start
params.doc: ISO YYYY-MM-DD (real name; docs say start_date).

params.name: date_range_end
params.doc: ISO YYYY-MM-DD (real name; docs say end_date).

params.name: platforms
params.doc: Array of strings; ad-platform spend filter (name-normalized).

returns: { action:'revenue_attribution', date_range, model, attribution_window_days, conversion_event, platforms_queried[], ga4_property_id, revenue_source, revenue_source_requested, revenue_source_confidence, available_revenue_sources[], totals:{total_spend,total_attributed_revenue,ground_truth_revenue,ground_truth_source,blended_roas}, breakdown:[{channel,spend,attributed_revenue,conversions,roas,cac,sessions}], warehouse:{...}|null, notes:{...}, warnings, errors }

params.name: tiktok_account_id
